channel.title: Omi Dev (fork)
channel.description: Notarized fork builds of the Omi desktop app.

item.title: Omi desktop (fork) 0.1.11
item.description:
Fork desktop build 0.1.11 (signed + notarized, bundle com.omi.desktop-dev).
## Changes - Rewind screen capture no longer replaces the traffic-light buttons of the app you are using with the macOS window-sharing badge - Synced upstream BasedHardware desktop changes through v0.12.339 (2026-09-11)

item.title: Omi desktop (fork) 0.1.10
item.description:
Fork desktop build 0.1.10 (signed + notarized, bundle com.omi.desktop-dev).
## Changes - Fork builds now update themselves: the app follows the fork's own Sparkle feed and installs new releases on quit, instead of waiting for brew upgrade.
